Emil Siewiorek's players defeated BBTS Bielsko-Biała 3:1 in their own hall, and won 3:2 in their rival's territory. In both matches, Gieksa's most effective volleyball player was Michał Superlak. If the Bielsko team wants to keep their chances of advancing to the elite, they must find a way to stop this player

programme.title: Women's volleyball: Champions League - final match: VakifBank SK - Eczacibasi Dynavit Istanbul
programme.desc: It's time for the finale. Teams from this city will face each other in Istanbul. VakifBank will fight for the seventh Champions Cup, and Eczacibasi for the second. In the semi-final, Tijana Bosković and company defeated the defending champion team Imoco Conegliano with Joanna Wołosz after a tie-break. Five sets were needed to determine the winners also in the match between Eczacibasi and Savino Del Bene Scandicci. Magdalena Stysiak scored as many as 30 points for the Turkish team

programme.title: Lion rules – Einstein must go! | E01
programme.desc: In the floodplains of the lower reaches of the African Kuando River, called Chobe, a pride of lions dominates the local ecosystem. The clan, consisting of a dozen or so individuals, is ruled by two brothers and a brave female. The rebellious young lion Einstein stands out from them. Even though he should leave the family herd, he stubbornly sticks to his loved ones. With the arrival of the dry season, lions start fighting for survival. They try to protect their territory and offspring from rivals. When the cubs appear, Einstein decides to leave for good and start a new life. The authors present members of the Waterfront lion pride. In addition to the males, they are composed of eight lionesses and a group of ten cubs. Standing out from the rest of the team is the adult, rebellious Einstein, who has never left home, even though he is of an appropriate age. Rivals from the Outsiders pack take actions that determine the fate of the youngster. However, when faced with trials, he shows exceptionally strong stubbornness. South Africa. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Rekin alpha

They analyze their speed, hunting skills and bravado in this respect... Great Britain, New Zealand. 2024. documentary film

programme.title: Wild West | E03
programme.desc: A story about a legendary land known from western movies. Documentarians present extraordinary landscapes dominated by sun-baked deserts, red rocks of canyons and rocky gorges. However, you can also find huge snow-covered mountains here... Great Britain. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Greater Africa – Okawanago Delta | E03
programme.desc: An extraordinary and fascinating adventure in the last wild, majestic deserts of Africa. The creators present a completely new look at the wonders of the Dark Continent and its amazing nature. The Okavango Delta is one of the most beautiful places in Africa. The world's largest inland delta, covering an area of ​​two million hectares, is known for its unique landscape and extraordinary natural wealth. South Africa. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: David Attenborough: Te wspaniałe jajka
programme.desc: Bird eggs nurture new life, protecting it from the outside world while allowing it to breathe. They are strong enough not to break under the full weight of the incubating parent, and fragile enough for the chick to escape. From creation to hatching, Sir David Attenborough reveals the rich process behind these natural wonders. Along the way, he shares stories about the eggs of a whole range of birds - from swans and their aquatic world, to the cliffs where the common guillemot lives and lays its eggs... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Our Bad Winter – Survival | E03

programme.desc: In a fight between a predator, the creators of the program explore how deception and speed of action can mean the difference between life and death. Even the fastest hunters use tricks to deceive their prey. Australia. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Spring | E03
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. d/s Air crash investigations. The pilot's last mistake
programme.desc: On routine flight #3597 from Berlin to Zurich, the Crossair aircraft makes a pre-landing maneuver. This is one of the last flights scheduled to arrive. Just a few minutes before landing, the pilots suddenly discover that they cannot see the runway. They decide to stop the maneuver and turn on all four engines at full power to gain altitude and approach the next circle, but they do it too late. The plane hits the treetops with its landing gear and falls onto a hill. Arriving experts are combing the crash site and debris in search of black boxes. However, they will be able to solve the mystery of the fall of Crossair Flight 3597 only by delving into the past. Led by: Stephen Bogert, Jonathan Aris. Canada, 2003-present documentary

programme.desc: An energetic Dutch Shepherd named Safira is under the constant supervision of Muna, a ferret. They are constantly together, and Safira never attacks Muna. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: d/s Best friends. 1 p.
programme.desc: We meet a four-year-old puppy named Puck and his best friend, Larry the spurred tortoise. The restless Pyrenean mountain dog Eli finally finds his best friend in Laura the donkey. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: d/s Best friends. 2 s.
programme.desc: Peking duck Rudy doesn't let other ducks get close to his friend, Barclay the golden retriever. The deaf horse Splash found helpers - the goats Thelma and Louise. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: d/s Best friends. 3 s.
programme.desc: The relationship between Aspen the hawk and Oses the Newfoundland/Border Collie/Beagle mix is ​​incredibly symbolic! Jersey cow Jerry finds a friend, Gracie, a donkey with attitude. Dir.: Sarah Marino. Starring: Sara Marino, Scott Bainbridge. Canada, 2014

programme.title: In the animal world. 3 s.
programme.desc: A program about the amazing world of wildlife, its representatives, their habits and habitat. The fauna of our planet is many-sided and diverse, and this is not surprising, because living conditions in different parts of the Earth are very different. You cannot find even the smallest place on the map - neither on land nor in the ocean - where living organisms do not live. Flying and crawling, with and without shells, furry and smooth, big and tiny, menacing and funny creatures, all of them are our neighbors on the Planet and need careful and respectful treatment. The program will introduce viewers to individual representatives of the motley fauna and talk about the amazing abilities of our smaller brothers to survive and adapt to harsh living conditions. Russia, 1968, educational

programme.title: d/f Where the soul lives. Indian elephants
programme.desc: In this series you will meet the Asian elephant - a symbol of wisdom. China, 2022

programme.title: In the animal world. 16 p.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/s Underwater China. 3 s.
programme.desc: We invite you on an exciting journey under the waters of China! The project opens up amazing underwater worlds to viewers, hidden from the eyes of most people. We explore unique ecosystems where rare species of fish, shellfish and other sea creatures live. You will see how the life of underwater inhabitants changes depending on the time of year and climatic conditions, and learn how local residents care about the preservation of these fragile ecosystems. 2019

programme.title: d/s Superpowers of animals. Earth
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? How do bats and moths use their unusual ears and antennae for orientation? In each episode, we explore how these features, which at first glance seem strange, play a key role in survival. Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic, 2015

programme.title: d/s Superpowers of animals. Communication
programme.desc: A series that explores the amazing senses of animals and their evolution. Why do snakes have forked tongues and elephants have huge ears? Like humans, animals rely on their senses to find food, communicate, and avoid danger. An in-depth look at how evolution has created unique tools to adapt to our environment. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic, 2015

programme.title: d/f Beyond the horizon: Wildlife of Saudi Arabia
programme.desc: Saudi Arabia is discovering its amazing natural resources. The documentary features rare species including Arabian leopards, gazelles and oryxes, and how they are conserved in the wild. The camera demonstrates the unique habits of these animals and the efforts of scientists and ecologists aimed at protecting and restoring populations. Saudi Arabia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Amazing animal families. 3 s.
programme.desc: Even in the animal kingdom, some families are very different. When it comes to courtship, wild guanacos make their brave cousins, the llamas, blush with shame. Australia, 2019

programme.title: d/f Wild Australia
programme.desc: Australia is not only a continent with a unique nature, but also home to many rare and amazing species of flora and fauna. The project explores ecosystems, amazing natural phenomena and the lives of the most unusual animals living in the Australian wild. France, 2024

programme.title: d/f Albatross and Penguin
programme.desc: In the midst of the short summer on the Falkland Islands, albatrosses and penguins face different fates, but both species have one common goal - to raise their chicks. On these lands of the South Atlantic, a real struggle for procreation is unfolding, where birds rush to fulfill an important mission in a limited time. France

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Great Desert Race
programme.desc: Desert animals have evolved to survive in hot, dry conditions. Like scorpions, which have existed since the beginning of life. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Herbivores
programme.desc: The African savanna has seen thousands of different battles. How do elephants survive on a diet that would bring any vegetarian to their knees? Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/f Return of the birds of the lake
programme.desc: Birds are constantly fighting for survival, finding food, choosing partners and nesting sites in an industrial city where life was almost destroyed two decades ago. In this film we will see how nature and animals adapt to harsh conditions and recover despite the influence of human activity. Slovenia, 2018

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. Lords of the sky
programme.desc: Eagles and other “lords of the skies” play a key role in the wildlife food chain. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife. American mountains
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA, 2012

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 9 p.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Dir.: Kala Ellis. Australia, 2024

programme.title: d/s Amazing animals of Australia. 10 s.
programme.desc: Viewers will travel across Australia to see how its inhabitants survive in hot deserts, tropical forests and rocky plains. The heroes of the series are the most creative, aggressive and inquisitive representatives of the fauna, surprising with their instincts and habits. Dir.: Kala Ellis. Australia, 2024

programme.title: d/f Wild Borneo
programme.desc: Sabah is the heart of Borneo, an island shrouded in fog and mystery. This region, whose jungle is over 130 million years old, is impressive with its high mountains and mysterious rivers. Ancient rainforests and a unique ecosystem hide rare species of animals and plants, creating a unique world that makes you admire Borneo's wildlife. 2015

programme.title: d/s Galapagossa. At the edge of the Earth. Survival
programme.desc: It is home to many species of plants and animals that are found nowhere else on the planet. Unfortunately, due to human activity and climate change, some species have become endangered. Dir.: Chan Won-joon. South Korea, 2018

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Born Warriors
programme.desc: Males and females of some animals fight each other mercilessly. They do not have the goal of killing each other, although this sometimes happens. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Run faster than the wind
programme.desc: Due to the constant hunting of predators, prey must adapt and develop defensive skills, otherwise they will face a sad fate. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Return of the disappeared. Return of the Tiger
programme.desc: The series is about how nature restores balance after human intervention. The story of how Amur tigers, beavers, leopards and other species that were on the verge of extinction began to thrive again. The restoration of ecosystems and the return of extinct species is the result of the joint efforts of scientists, environmental organizations and people who care about preserving our planet. South Korea, 2023

programme.title: Not the heavenly life of the Garden of Eden. 2 s.
programme.desc: The Singapore Botanic Garden is the only tropical garden recognized by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site. There is an incredible variety of tropical flora and fauna here. Together with the local inhabitants, we will spend a year of our lives and see the dramatic life of wild nature hidden from prying eyes. Singapore, 2022, educational

programme.title: d/s Water World of Komodo Island. Mysterious cave and sunken ship
programme.desc: Explore Komodo Island, a unique ecosystem that will take you back 100 million years. You will see huge Komodo dragons, a variety of sharks and rays, sea turtles and dolphins. Hidden in the sunken cave is the mystery of Ebu-gogo, a mysterious creature that scientists still cannot solve. Director: Andrzej Misiuk. Germany, 2021

programme.title: d/f Africa from a bird's eye view
programme.desc: The film gives viewers a stunning bird's eye view of Africa. The camera captures everything from the Sahara Desert to the Serengeti National Park, from the market squares of Marrakesh to the roaring waterfalls of the Upper Nile. Morocco and Libya, Ethiopia and Gabon, Tanzania and Kenya - discover all corners of the African continent. 2021

programme.title: d/f Otters of the Shetland Islands
programme.desc: The protected Shetland Islands are one of the last untouched places in the UK, rich in unique natural wonders. Our documentary journey will immerse viewers in this amazing world, where the harsh northern landscape hides the life of one of the largest otter populations in Europe. Dir.: Jacqueline Farmer. France, 2019

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Survival of the fittest
programme.desc: There are many examples of evolution in the wildlife world. Whales, for example, evolved from land animals to aquatic mammals. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Race of life. Big cats
programme.desc: Leopards may be one of the most well-adapted big cats, but lions have few enemies to hunt them. Czech Republic, USA, 2015

programme.title: d/f In the skies
programme.desc: They have been living next to us for a long time - on roofs, in parks, near train stations and landfills. Birds have learned to use the human world to their advantage: building nests out of trash, foraging for food in noisy yards, and avoiding danger. How did they do it? What habits help them survive? Spain, 2016

programme.title: d/s Ingenious sea hunters. Alaska/Norway
programme.desc: Whales in Alaska are organizing a joint hunt while others battle killer whales for herring off the coast of Norway. Killer whales surround schools of fish underwater and invent an underwater box. France, 2020

programme.title: d/s Ingenious sea hunters. Argentina/South Africa
programme.desc: In Argentina, Jorge talks about the tactics of killer whales in driving their prey aground. France, 2020

programme.desc: (GB 14). Cat content makes you happy: the secret to the success of cat videos viewed millions of times. The documentary shows what our most popular pet can do, from hunting to swimming. The sweet factor comes on all by itself...

programme.title: Destination Myanmar
programme.desc: Myanmar is one of the most beautiful landscapes in Asia. The former Burma, with its pristine habitats and wetlands, provides protection for endangered species such as the wild Asian elephant. (Station info).

programme.title: Wonderful world of the Pacific & wild Antarctica
programme.desc: With the start of the Antarctic winter, whales and seabirds migrate to warmer climes, but not the emperor penguin. The majestic tailcoats begin to hatch their eggs. (Station info).

programme.title: The Tuamotu Islands: natural wonders in the South Seas
programme.desc: This underwater world is unparalleled: the Tumakohua Pass, in the southern part of the Fakarava Atoll. The moon and the tides determine the fate of many animal species here. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: Leopard Olimba has to defend her newly won territory. She holds her own against brazen hyenas who steal her prey - and against another female leopard. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: In the middle of the rainy season, a lioness gives birth to her cubs. Only one of them survives - and receives support from his older half-brother. Together the lion cubs face the dangers of the wilderness. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: For three years, the two lion brothers of the Nsefu pride dominated Luangwa National Park. Now several rivals see their chance to put an early end to the duo's reign. (Station info).

programme.title: Africa's hunters
programme.desc: After a period of sheltered growing up, hyena Mizumu is on her own. Now the fight for survival begins for the young male. Can he brave the numerous dangers of the wilderness? (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: Matriarch Dagmar goes into labor after 15 months of pregnancy. Meanwhile, the Sumatran orangutan troop is recovering from the fire that devastated their habitat last year. (Station info).

programme.title: Zoo and stuff – wild animals!
programme.desc: The population of Asian short-clawed otters has grown rapidly. Mother Annie and father Wallace can sit back and relax. At the dik-dik antelopes, Khari and Shani have a baby. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Kate Humble and Ben Fogle marvel at how lovingly the zookeepers care for each species, especially the new, endangered African wild dog. (Station info).

programme.title: Forest of wild ponies
programme.desc: Great Britain's second-smallest national park in the south of the country has a lot to offer: The New Forest has served as a hunting ground since 1079 for King William the Conqueror (1027/28–1087). Since then, residents' livestock have been allowed to move freely in the forest and agriculture in the area has been stopped. Around 4,500 very special residents, the New Forest ponies, actively manage the landscape here alongside cattle, donkeys, pigs and sheep. The historic forest is therefore seen as a model for how species-rich landscapes in the middle of Europe can be preserved in the future. Apart from the deciduous and mixed forest, meadows and heathland make up over half of the nature reserve.

programme.title: Spines, fur and feathers
programme.desc: Fur, feathers, scales, mussel shells: They are all part of the outer layer of a living being. Most of the time they also ensure survival. How have these shells evolved over millions of years? (Station info).

programme.title: SWAMP PEOPLE S15 EP04

programme.title: MOUNTAIN MEN S13 EP11

programme.title: THE CURSE OF OAK ISLAND S12 EP11

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: NỮ CẢNH SÁT ĐẶC NHIỆM - HIDDEN HEROINE
programme.desc: Một băng đảng ma túy đang cố thủ ở khu vực Đông Châu. Mei Jing thuộc Đơn vị biệt kích nữ Thunderbolt, dẫn đầu nhóm của cô tấn công cơ sở ma túy, nhưng họ đang bị phục kích và danh tính nội gián của cha Mei bị lộ. Sau một trận chiến khốc liệt, Mei và nhóm của cô đã đánh bại thành công băng đảng ma túy và giải cứu cha cô.

programme.title: KẺ ĐÀO TẨU - NIGHT WALK
programme.desc: Frank bị buộc tội giết người sau khi bạn gái của anh bị giết trong một vụ việc bi thảm trong chuyến thăm Trung Đông của họ. Anh ta bị đưa đến một nhà tù, nơi anh ta gặp một tù nhân Hồi giáo, người đã giúp anh ta lên kế hoạch vượt ngục để chứng minh mình vô tội. Khi người bạn đột ngột qua đời, liệu Frank có thể trốn thoát thành công và tìm lại công lý cho mình?

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: LIỆT THÁM - FIERCE COP
programme.desc: Để cứu con trai mình bị bọn buôn người bắt cóc, cảnh sát Zhang không ngừng truy lùng họ và vô tình phát hiện mình có liên quan đến một vụ bắt cóc trẻ em lớn. Trong quá trình đó, anh hợp tác với một người phụ nữ bí ẩn để phá vỡ tổ chức tội phạm quốc tế và giải cứu con trai mình.

programme.title: ANH HÙNG THỜI LOẠN - YOUNG HEROES OF CHAOTIC TIMES
programme.desc: Câu chuyện này lấy bối cảnh ở Thượng Hải vào cuối triều đại nhà Thanh, kể về một chàng trai trẻ, Chen Zhen, người đã vươn lên trở thành anh hùng dân tộc sau khi chịu đựng gian khổ và vượt qua thử thách trong cuộc sống.

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!

programme.title: LIỆT THÁM - FIERCE COP
programme.desc: Để cứu con trai mình bị bọn buôn người bắt cóc, cảnh sát Zhang không ngừng truy lùng họ và vô tình phát hiện mình có liên quan đến một vụ bắt cóc trẻ em lớn. Trong quá trình đó, anh hợp tác với một người phụ nữ bí ẩn để phá vỡ tổ chức tội phạm quốc tế và giải cứu con trai mình.

programme.title: GIÁO PHÁI BÁO THÙ - WU LIN: THE SOCIETY
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 2050, nơi tình trạng ô nhiễm và virus tràn lan buộc mọi người phải đeo khẩu trang chỉ để thở, tuy nhiên cuộc sống hàng ngày vẫn tiếp tục như thường lệ. Khi hàng loạt cái chết bí ẩn nổ ra, cảnh sát nghi ngờ kẻ giết người hàng loạt trong khi có tin đồn về một con quỷ đang nổi cơn thịnh nộ. Giờ đây, cảnh sát phải chạy đua để làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn và ngăn chặn các vụ giết người trước khi sự hoảng loạn bao trùm thành phố.

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: THẠCH HẦU TRỞ VỀ - THE MONKEY IS BACK
programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?
